say:1:1033318001:1.text: The sacred Lucent Tree was given to the forest by Misarte. If it gets corrupted, so too might the soil and water.
say:1:1033318001:1.source_cn: 流荧树是弥萨忒赐福给丛林的圣树，如果它被腐化了，那这里...
say:1:1033318001:1.male: The sacred Lucent Tree was given to the forest by Misarte. If it gets corrupted, so too might the soil and water.
say:1:1033318001:1.female: The sacred Lucent Tree was given to the forest by Misarte. If it gets corrupted, so too might the soil and water.

say:2:1033318002:1.text: And then the herbs might barely work anymore...
say:2:1033318002:1.source_cn: 草药的功效，也许会大大减退……
say:2:1033318002:1.male: And then the herbs might barely work anymore...
say:2:1033318002:1.female: And then the herbs might barely work anymore...

say:3:1033318003:1.text: If that really happens, what if people get injured?
say:3:1033318003:1.source_cn: 如果真是那样，受伤的人可怎么办？！
say:3:1033318003:1.male: If that really happens, what if people get injured?
say:3:1033318003:1.female: If that really happens, what if people get injured?
